summary: PIM Manager moves to Microsoft software that is supported until November 2028.

fixes.title: Runs on Microsoft's supported platform
fixes.text: PIM Manager now runs on Microsoft's long-term supported platform, supported to November 2028, and is patched at every build. The earlier platform reached end of support on 10 November 2026.

fixes.title: Home permission check works again
fixes.text: The permission check on the Home page no longer fails with an error at some installations.
